long_description:
Saffron Sounds Vol. 2: A South Asian Coffee Rave

Live DJs. Real coffee. Zero alcohol needed.

The daytime desi rave is back. Last time 135+ of us packed the floor, and Vol. 2 is bigger.

WHAT TO EXPECT

• Live DJs spinning Bollywood, Afro House and more

• Real coffee on-site from The Brownstone Social's café

• A fully alcohol-free, daytime dance floor

• Photographer on-site capturing the day

DETAILS

📅 Sunday, November 22, 2026

🕛 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM

📍 The Brownstone Social, 109 W 25th St, New York, NY

🔞 18+ only. Bring a valid photo ID.

GOOD TO KNOW

• Coffee and drinks are available for purchase at the café and are not included with your ticket.

• Photos and video will be taken at this event. By attending, you consent to being photographed and filmed, and to the use of that content for promotion.

• Doors open at 12 PM. Arrive early to beat the line.

Presented by Desi After Hours. Follow @desiafterhours for updates.
